# Sleep Calculator & Cycle Planner

> A highly polished, science-based suite of Sleep Cycle Calculators, Nap Helpers, and Circadian Hygiene planners to help you calculate bedtimes, track sleep logs, and wake up refreshed.

## Core Calculators

- [Sleep Calculator (Home)](https://sleepcalculater.online/) - Calculate optimal bedtime & wake up times based on natural 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [90-Minute Sleep Cycle Calculator](https://sleepcalculater.online/sleep-cycle-calculator-90-minutes) - Calculate custom sleep intervals and exact bedtime/wake-up alignments.
- [Student Sleep Calculator](https://sleepcalculater.online/student-sleep-calculator) - Optimize exam-night bedtimes for peak memory retrieval and visual focus.
- [Night Shift Sleep Calculator](https://sleepcalculater.online/shift-work-sleep-calculator) - Custom daytime sleep schedules and anchor rest periods for shift workers.
- [Wake Up Between Cycles Calculator](https://sleepcalculater.online/wake-up-between-sleep-cycles) - Find exact alarm settings to wake up during natural cycle transitions.
- [Ideal Bedtime by Wake-Up Time](https://sleepcalculater.online/ideal-bedtime-based-on-wake-up-time) - Calculate customized bedtime schedules tailored to your age demographic.
